heroHeadline: IRGC Threatens US Bases and Ships if Ground Invasion Begins
heroSubtitle: Day 222 (October 7, 2026): Iran's IRGC warns it will strike US military bases and naval vessels in the region if a ground invasion of Iran is launched, as analysis tallies 81 US aircraft and drones — worth $3.3 billion — lost in the conflict to date.
